about: P1 R1 form library: the neck and the trapezius (OURS, designed; sliders.py rule "field", laid after the head join: post_join). R2 measured the yoke in B's rest shape: MakeHuman's reference under her head is a shrug (its shoulder top 25 mm under the chin at 17 cm out, 0-2 mm at 5-9 cm), the sliders' and stance's drop reach the outer shoulder but the join holds the neck's base at the reference. These fields set the neck by design: its length (the head placed higher on it), the trapezius' height and slope, the neck's girth.

neck_length.why: the neck's length: the head lifts 12 mm at v = 1 (head_move: the whole baked head, the Head joint placed from it) and the neck under it stretches to meet it (1 at the ring, easing to 0 by 7 cm from it): a long neck reads elegant and confident

trap_drop.why: the trapezius height and slope: its top near the neck carried down (26 mm at 5.5-8.5 cm out, easing to 0 at 2 cm and 11.5 cm; the back and top only: z under -2 cm, easing over 7 cm) over an 8 mm drop of the whole shoulder top (7-22 cm out), the ring held (0 within 0.5 cm, full from 3 cm): the neck side wall rises clean out of a sloped trapezius instead of a mound at the jaw. Rest profile at v = 1 (her_r1, the shoulder top under the chin at 7/9/11/13/15/17 cm): -33/-60/-66/-78/-82/-88 mm (was -6/-19/-44/-58/-62/-68)

neck_girth.why: the neck girth under the ring: in 6 mm a side at v = 1 between 1.4 and 4 cm from the ring (easing to 0 at the ring and 7 cm down), above the shoulder line: a slim neck that waists a little under the jaw and flares into the trapezius
